about: Makeda answers the Israelites’ plea of the previous chapter: she will not treat them as servants but honour them as fathers and teachers, and she bids them teach the people. She speaks of the water of knowledge she has not yet drunk to the full, prays in a long run of petitions that wisdom may hold her fast, and tells how she dived into the sea for wisdom’s treasures, for her people and the nations around. She tells the lords that God has given them a seed in Zion and a dwelling-place among them, charges them to love justice and give up their old practices, sorcery among them, on pain of plunder, and bids Azariah tell of Zion’s love for the heavenly king.

sentences.n: ወአውሥአት ‘and she answered’ (ወ- + causative አውሥአ, 3fs perfect), then ወትቤሎሙ ‘and she said to them’ (ትቤ, 3fs of the defective verb ‘say’, + ሎሙ). አኮ is the negative ‘it is not’. ዘትብሉ ‘what you say’ (ዘ- + 2mp imperfect of ብህለ) answers the plea at the end of ch. 88, ‘make us as your servants’. ንሬስየክሙ is ረሰየ ‘make, set, treat as’ in the 1cp imperfect with -ክሙ ‘you’; I take it as a plain present ‘we regard/make you’ (it could be a wish, ‘let us make you’). ወከመ ‘and as’ repeats ከመ ‘as’. The direct speech opens here and runs to the ፨ that ends unit 24; the last unit is narrative again.

sentences.i: for you are the keepers of the law of God and the guides of the commandment of the God of Israel, the people of God’s house and the keepers of Zion, the ark of the law of God; and there is nothing that we would transgress (?) from your commandment, for you will be a guide for us on the way of God, away from all evil;
sentences.n: A string of construct chains: ዐቃብያነ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር ‘keepers-of his-law of-God’ (the owner is named after the suffix, ሕጉ … ለእግዚኣብሔር, as elsewhere), ወመራሕያነ ትእዛዙ ‘guides-of his command’, ወሰብአ ቤቱ ‘men-of his house’ (rendered ‘people of his house’, as in ch. 88). ወዐቃብያኒሃ ለጽዮን ‘and her keepers, of Zion’, then ታቦተ ሕጉ ‘ark-of his law’ in apposition: Zion is the Ark, the central claim of the book. ዘንትዐደው ‘that we transgress’ (ዘ- + tä-stem ተዐደወ); the relative ዘ- with a first-person verb is loose, ‘nothing that we transgress’, and I give it with (?). ትከውኑነ ‘you will be for us’ (2mp imperfect + -ነ). በኀበ ‘in the presence of’ here is uncertain (?); I take መርሐ በኀበ ፍኖተ እግዚኣብሔር as ‘a guide on/at the way of God’. እምኵሉ እኩይ ‘from all evil’ gives the direction ‘away from’.

sentences.i: But proclaim to all this people and teach them words of knowledge, for they have never heard the like until today;
sentences.n: አይድዑ is a causative imperative (2mp, ‘make known, proclaim’; the root, ይድዐ, I give from memory and hold loosely (?)). ለዝንቱ ኵሉ ሕዝብ ‘to this whole people’. ወመሀርዎሙ ‘and teach them’ (መሀረ + -ሙ). ቃላተ አእምሮ ‘words of knowledge’; አእምሮ, ‘knowing, knowledge’, is the key word of the chapter and I keep ‘knowledge’ for it throughout, leaving ‘understanding’ for ልቡና. አልቦ አመ ሰምዑ … ‘there is no time they heard … ’, i.e. they never heard; ዘእንበለ ዮም ‘except/before today’; ዘከመዝ ‘such a thing’.

sentences.i: As for me, I have not yet drunk my fill of the water of knowledge, for it is sweeter than honey, and more quenching than wine; it satisfies and fills (?) with wisdom, it bewilders (?) the understanding, it leaves one weak (?) as a man who is drunk, and faltering (?) as one who has been running, and ያሀ ፉ (?) as one who carries a heavy load on a steep (?) path in a land of heat and the blaze of the sun;
sentences.n: Here the speech turns to the metaphor of the ‘water of knowledge’ (ማየ አእምሮ), which she has not yet drunk to the full (ኢረወይክዎ, ረወየ ‘drink one’s fill’, 1cs perfect + -ዎ ‘it’). ይጥዕም እምነ መዓር ‘is sweet more than honey’ (እምነ before a noun gives the comparative); ወያረዊ ‘and quenches’ (causative). Then a run of verbs whose roots I cannot check without Dillmann, so all of them are hedged: ያጐሥዕ (‘fills’? the root ጐሥዐ is otherwise ‘push, strike’ in my memory), ያስዖዝዝ (‘bewilders’), ያልሕስ (‘weakens’), ያለጸልጽ (‘makes falter’); the sense is plain, that this water overwhelms like drink or labour. ወያሀ ፡ ፉ is printed with a stray space (perhaps one word ያሀፉ); I keep the two pieces as printed and cannot place them (perhaps ‘pants’ (?)). ከመ ዘሰክረ ‘like one who got drunk’ (ከመ ዘ- + perfect). ፍኖተ ዐቀብ ‘a path of ʿäqäb’, taken as ‘steep, slope’ (?). ላህበ ፀሐይ ‘flame of the sun’. ‘Heat’ here is ሐሩር, so the picture is a desert march.

sentences.i: When the hearts of the wise are opened to prophecy and teaching, they do not fear a king on account of the greatness of his glory, if he has turned aside from the way of God.
sentences.n: ተከሥተ ‘was opened’ is a singular verb with the plural ‘hearts’ (አልባቢሆሙ, ‘their hearts’); the pattern is common. ለጠቢባን ‘to the wise’ (ጠቢብ, plural). ለትንቢት ወለምህሮ ‘for prophecy and for teaching’ (ምህሮ is the verbal noun of መሀረ). ኢይፈርህዎ ለንጉሥ ‘they do not fear the king’; the ለ- marks the object and is doubled by -ዎ ‘him’. በእንተ ዕበየ ክብሩ ‘because of the greatness of his glory’; ዕበይ is in the construct. ለእመ ‘if’ introduces the condition; ተግሕሠ as above, ‘turned aside’ (?). The point, for the Israelites and for her son the king, is that wisdom is free to rebuke a king who strays.

sentences.l: As-for-me I-pray O-Lord God-of Israel holy-one-of holy-ones: give-me that I-follow wisdom and-not he-is-cast-off; give-me that I-profit in-her and-not he-grows-slack (?); give-me that I-take-root (?) in-her and-not he-shakes; give-me that I-lean in-her and-not he-gives-way (?); give-me that I-am-sheltered (?) in-her and-not he-is-torn-away (?); give-me that I-am-built in-her and-not he-departs (?); give-me that I-leap (?) in-her and-not he-grows-weary; give-me that I-stand in-her and-not he-falls; give-me that I-lean-on-staff in-her and-not he-staggers; give-me that I-am-shod (?) in-her and-not he-lags-behind (?); give-me that I-hold-fast in-her and-not he-sinks; give-me that I-am-firm in-her and-not he-is-torn (?); give-me that I-abide in-her; in-her-ስንኣ I-am-satisfied at-her-table, and-not-he-ሜጽራ (?) I-drink-her (?), and-not-he-drinks-his-fill-of-her (?) I-am-sated-with-her (?), and-not-he-spits-her-out;
sentences.i: As for me, I pray, O Lord, God of Israel, Holy One of holy ones: grant me to follow wisdom and not be cast aside; grant me to profit by her and not grow slack (?); grant me to take root (?) in her and not be shaken; grant me to lean on her and not give way (?); grant me to be sheltered (?) in her and not be torn away (?); grant me to be built up in her and not depart (?); grant me to leap (?) in her and not grow weary; grant me to stand in her and not fall; grant me to lean on a staff in her and not stagger; grant me to be shod (?) in her and not lag behind (?); grant me to hold fast to her and not sink; grant me to be firm in her and not be torn (?); grant me to abide in her; by her ስንኣ (?) I am satisfied at her table; may no one ሜጽራ (?) her as I drink her, nor drink his fill of her (?) as I am sated with her, nor spit her out.
sentences.n: The prayer opens a long run of petitions of one pattern, ሀበኒ ከመ [1cs imperfect] ባቲ ወኢ[3ms verb] ‘give me that I [do so-and-so] in her, and [may it] not …’. ሀበኒ is the imperative of ወሀበ + -ኒ ‘me’; ከመ + the 1cs imperfect gives the purpose; ባቲ is በ- ‘in, by’ + -ቲ ‘her’, wisdom (ጥበብ, feminine). I render ባቲ ‘in her’ or ‘by her’ and the ወኢ- clause as an infinitive, ‘and not be …’. The grammar of that clause is odd: the verbs are 3ms (ይትገደፍ ‘he/it is cast off’) with no stated subject, although the sense seems to be ‘and that I not …’; I keep the 3ms in `l` and ‘not be …’ in the English. The verbs are mostly ones I can only guess at without Dillmann: እጠቀም ‘profit’ (ጠቀመ), ይንኀል ‘grow slack’ (?), ይንሐድ ‘depart’ (?), እሣረር ‘take root’ (ሠረረ, ‘be firm, rooted’ (?)), ያንቀልቅል ‘shake’, እትዐመድ ‘lean’ (ዐምድ ‘pillar’), ይጽነን ‘give way’ (?), እሰወር ‘be hidden/sheltered’ (?), ይትቀላዕ ‘be torn away’ (?), እትሐነጽ ‘be built’. እግዚኦ is the vocative ‘O Lord’; ቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን ‘holy one of holy ones’, a title of God (the masculine ቅዱስ, not the place ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ‘Holy of Holies’). This unit and the next two are one unpunctuated stretch in the source (no ። or ፤ until ወኢይተፍኣ ፤), about 79 words; I have cut it at the end of ወኢይንሐድ and at ባቲ before በስንኣሃ, so that no single unit passes 45 words. [Following clause:] The petitions continue in the same pattern; the unit begins at ሀበኒ because the ወኢ- clause belongs to the petition before it. Pairs: እትወርዘው ‘leap, spring’ (?) / ይድክም ‘grow weary’; እቁም ‘stand’ / ይደቅ ‘fall’; እትመርጐዝ ‘lean on a staff’ (መርጐዝ ‘staff’) / ይተንትን ‘stagger, totter’; እሠአን ‘be shod’ (from ሠአን ‘sandal’ (?)) / ይድኀፅ ‘lag behind’ (?); እትአኀዝ ‘hold fast’ / ይሰጠም ‘sink’ (the sinking prepares the diving image); እጽናዕ ‘be firm’ / ይሠረም ‘be torn’ (?). The last petition, እንበር ባቲ ‘that I abide in her’ (ነበረ), has no ወኢ- clause and ends the series. The picture is a traveller: stand, staff, sandals, grip, foothold. [Following clause:] በስንኣሃ is በ- + ስንኣ (?) + -ሃ ‘her’; I do not know ስንኣ (perhaps ‘bounty, sweetness’ (?)). በማእዳ ‘at her table’ (ማእድ). እጽገብ ‘I am satisfied’ (ጸገበ, as in ያጸግብ in the ‘water of knowledge’ unit). Then three more ወኢ- clauses with 3ms verbs and ‘her’, each followed by a 1cs verb that also carries ‘her’: ወኢይሜጽራ እስትያ ‘and not … her, I drink her’ (ይሜጽራ is unknown to me (?); እስትያ is the 1cs imperfect of ሰትየ ‘drink’ + -ኣ ‘her’, the verb of ይሰትይዎ above); ወኢይረውያ እጽገባ ‘and let not [he] have his fill of her, I am sated with her’ (?) (ይረውያ is the simple stem of ረወየ ‘drink one’s fill’, the verb of ኢረወይክዎ above; 3ms + -ኣ ‘her’, not a causative; እጽገባ is the እጽገብ of this unit + -ኣ ‘her’); ወኢይተፍኣ ‘and not spit her out’ (ተፍአ, ‘spit, vomit’ (?)). As in the petitions, the 3ms verbs have no stated subject, and I give ‘may no one’ (?). The syntax is loose and the English is a hedged reconstruction (?). The thought is that the satiety of wisdom never cloys. (The petition run has no ፤ in the source, so it stands as one long unit of about 79 words rather than being cut mid-series.)

sentences.i: I was drunk with her, yet I did not stagger; I staggered for her sake, and they did not fall; they fell on her account; and I was not lost through her.
sentences.n: A string of paradoxes: ‘I did not stagger — I staggered’, ‘they did not fall — they fell’; the sense appears to be that she (wisdom) does not make the seeker fall in the way drink does, yet the seeker bears every hardship for her sake. ሰከርኩ ‘I became drunk’; ተንተንኩ ‘I staggered’ (the verb of ይተንትን in the petitions above); ወደቁ ‘they fell’ is a plural verb with no stated subject. በእንቲ ፡ አሃ is printed with a space; it is በእንቲአሃ ‘for her sake’ (as in the next unit), kept as printed.

sentences.i: For her sake I sank into the great sea, and I seized a pearl (?) in the ልጐተ (?) of its depths, that by what is in it I might be rich;
sentences.n: Here the sea-diving image begins, and it runs to the entry into the sun’s flame. ተሰጠምኩ ‘I sank’ (ሰጠመ, 1cs perfect, as in ይሰጠም). ባሕር ‘sea’; its depths are መዓምቅቲሃ, ‘her depths’, since ባሕር is treated as feminine (the ሃ cannot be wisdom here). ወአኀዝኩ ባሕርየ: ባሕርየ I take as the accusative of ባሕርይ ‘pearl’ (also ‘nature’; a pearl fits a diver and the wealth that follows) (?); the plain alternative is ባሕር + -የ ‘my sea’ (?). ልጐተ I cannot read; it follows በውስተ and precedes ‘her depths’, perhaps ‘bed, floor, ooze’ (?). በዘባቲ እብዕል ‘in what is in her I become rich’ (ዘ- relative, ባቲ ‘in her’, እብዕል 1cs imperfect, ባዕለ ‘be rich’). sentences.n: ኖምኩ ‘I slept’; ሐለምኩ ‘I dreamed’ (ሐለመ), a dream in the depths, perhaps the vision of wisdom. ዘእንበለ እትዐዘዝ በማይ ‘without that I be … by water’: ዘእንበለ + the 1cs subjunctive of ተዐዘዘ ‘be oppressed, afflicted’ (?). እንዘ ኮከብ ውስተ ሕፅንየ ‘while a star (was) in my bosom’ (ሕፅን ‘bosom, lap’). በእኂዞታ ‘in holding her’ (አኀዘ, verbal noun with ‘her’). ወአጽናዕክዋ ‘and I made her firm’ (causative ጸንዐ), then አኀዝክዋ ‘I held her’. ወኢየኀድጋ ‘and not he leaves her’ is 3ms again, though the sense is ‘I’ (as in the petitions). ‘Her’ shifts between the sea, the lamp and wisdom; the Geʿez does not mark it, and I keep ‘her’ throughout. sentences.i: For God gave us a seed in Zion and a dwelling-place in Jerusalem, and moreover he became a portion (?) with those whom he chose, the seed of Jacob, for he made her his dwelling-place, and she dwells with us;
sentences.n: ወሀበነ ‘he gave us’ (ወሀበ + -ነ). ዘርአ በጽዮን ‘seed in Zion’ and ማኅደረ በኢየሩሳሌም ‘dwelling in Jerusalem’: the Israelite lineage and the seat of God, in the claim of the book now passed to Ethiopia. ወዓዲ ኮነ ክፍለ: ‘and moreover he/it became a portion’ (?); ኮነ may stand for ኮንነ ‘we became’, as the published entry for this form notes elsewhere, which would give ‘we became a portion with those whom he chose’ (?). The portion language recalls Jeremiah 10:16 and Deuteronomy 32:9, ‘the Lord’s portion is his people, Jacob’, and I leave the subject open (?). ኀረየ ‘he chose’; ዘርአ ያዕቆብ ‘seed of Jacob’. ረሰያ ለማኅደሩ ትኅድር ምስሌነ: ‘he made her his dwelling-place, and she dwells with us’; ረሰየ + -ያ ‘her’ takes ለ- ‘into, as’ (ለማኅደሩ ‘as his dwelling-place’; ረሰየ … ለ- ‘make X into Y’), and the dwelling is Zion, i.e. the Ark; ትኅድር is 3fs imperfect, ‘she dwells’.

sentences.n: Two pairs set in balance with the contrastive -ሰ: እሙንቱሰ ‘they, for their part’ and ወንሕነሰ ‘and we, for our part’, each followed by እምይእዜ ‘from now’. ‘They’ are the other peoples, or those who rejected Zion; I do not claim to know which. ተዐቅጹ is a tä-stem 3mp perfect I take as ‘were shut in/constrained’ (?); ረታዕነ is the simple stem, 1cp perfect, of ረትዐ ‘be straight, right’ (intransitive, so ‘we are upright, in the right’, not ‘were made upright’) (?). ኀስሩ ‘they were diminished’ (ኀሠረ, spelled with ስ) and ተመነኑ ‘they were despised’ are both perfects, contrasted with ከበርነ ‘we have been honoured’ (ከበረ) and ተፈቀርነ ‘we have been loved’ (tä-stem passive of ፈቀረ ‘love’). እስከ ለዓለመ ዓለም ‘until for the age of the age’ is the common ‘for ever and ever’; ለትውልደ ትውልድ ዘይመጽእ ‘for the generation of the generation that comes’ (ዓለም and ትውልድ doubled in construct).

sentences.i: for God dwells with you, and the dwelling-place of his glory is among you, for you have become people of his house; and from now on give up your former (?) custom: ተጠይሮ (?) and idolatry (?), sorcery (?) and spells (?) and divination (?) and ሐረሰ (?);

The Geʿez has no ‘and’ before ተጠይሮ or ሰገለ, which I keep.

sentences.n: ወትቤሎ ‘and she said to him’ (ትቤ + ሎ), the queen addressing Azariah (the Azariah of ch. 88, written Azaryas in the Geʿez). Two imperatives, በል ‘say!’ and ንግር ‘tell!’ (the second of ነገረ). ዘከመ ‘how’; ታፈቅር is the 3fs imperfect of አፍቀረ ‘love’; ምስለ ንጉሥ ሰማያዊ is ‘with the heavenly king’, so ‘loves with’ means ‘is in loving union with’ (?). እግዝእትነ ‘our lady’ is Zion, as in ch. 88. glossary.ነዋኬዝ: ነዋ — behold (?) (interjection ነዋ with an unexplained ending -ኬዝ) (?)

glossary.እሰወር: ሰወረ — that I hide, am sheltered (?) (1cs subjunctive, G, s-w-r; G is transitive 'conceal', so the passive sense here is a guess) (?)

glossary.እትመርጐዝ: ተመርጐዘ — that I lean on a staff (1cs subjunctive, tä-stem denominative of መርጐዝ 'staff')

glossary.እትወርዘው: ተወርዘወ — that I leap, run (?) (1cs subjunctive, tä-stem quadriliteral, w-r-z-w) (?)

glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?)

glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ከበርነ: ከብረ — we are honoured, glorious (1cp perfect, G, k-b-r)
glossary.ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two') · 3ms form before a plural subject (ኮነ መዋዕሊሁ ፷ 'his days were sixty'); 'there was' (ኮነ ረኃብ 'there was a famine') · 'it was' of time (ሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'when it was time for supper'); ወኮነ ፀዋገ 'he became (grim)'
glossary.ኮንክሙ: ኮነ — you became (2mp perfect, G, k-w-n, ending -ክሙ)
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወሀበነ: ወሀበ — he gave us (3ms perfect, G, w-h-b + -ነ '1cp us'; the ወ is a root letter)
glossary.ወለምህሮ: ምህሮ — and for teaching (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'for' + noun, verbal noun of መሀረ)
glossary.ወለትውልደ: ትውልድ — and for the generation of (ወ- 'and' + ለ- 'for' + noun, construct)
glossary.ወለእመቦ: እመ — and if there is (ወ- + ለእመ conditional + ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወላህበ: ላህብ — and the flame, burning heat of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወሐረሰ: ሐረስ — and … (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, accusative; elsewhere 'ploughing', meaning here uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወሐሰትሰ: ሐሰት — and falsehood, indeed (ወ- 'and' + noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወሔብኩ: ወሀበ — and I … (?) (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect; the printed ሔ is unexplained: perhaps a slip for ወሀብኩ 'I gave', or from ሐበ 'draw (water)') (?)
glossary.ወመሀርዎሙ: መሀረ — and teach them! (ወ- 'and' + 2mp imperative, G + -ዎሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወመራሕያነ: መራሒ — and guides of, leaders of (ወ- + noun, plural መራሕያን, construct)
glossary.ወማኅደረ: ማኅደር — and dwelling-place of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወሥራየ: ሥራይ — and spells, magic (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወረድኩ: ወረደ — I went down, go down (1cs perfect, G, w-r-d; conditional after ወእመኒ 'even if') · I went down, narrative (ወረድኩ ከመ ዐቢይ መልሕቀ 'and I went down like a great anchor')
glossary.ወሰብአ: ሰብእ — and men (ወ- + noun; construct 'men of' in ሰብአ ቤቱ 'his household')
glossary.ወቀስመ: ቀስም — and divination (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, accusative; meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወቃልየ: ቃል — and my word (ወ- 'and' + noun + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወተመነኑ: ተመነነ — and they were despised (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of መነነ 'despise'; subject ሕዝበ እስራኤል)
glossary.ወተወልተውኩ: ተወልተወ — and I gleamed (?) (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect, tä-stem quadriliteral) (?)
glossary.ወተፈቀርነ: ፈቀረ — and we are loved (ወ- 'and' + 1cp perfect, tä-stem passive)
glossary.ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
glossary.ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወኅድጉ: ኀደገ — and abandon! (ወ- 'and' + 2mp imperative, G, ḫ-d-g)
glossary.ወነሣእኩ: ነሥአ — and I took (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወንቅረብ: ቀረበ — and let us draw near (ወ- 'and' + 1cp jussive, G, q-r-b)
glossary.ወንዋዩ: ንዋይ — and his goods (ወ- 'and' + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted -ዩ)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአብርሀተኒ: አብርሀ — and she made me shine (ወ- 'and' + 3fs perfect, causative + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወአኀዝኩ: አኀዘ — and I began, took hold (ወ- + 1sg perfect, ʾ-ḫ-z; with following verb 'began to') · and I took hold of (ወአኀዝኩ ባሕርየ 'and I took hold of a pearl (?)'; with a noun object)
glossary.ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንትሙኒ: አንትሙ — and you too (ወ- + 2mp pronoun + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአንከርኩ: አንከረ — and I marvelled (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and knowledge (ወ- + verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.ወአውሥአት: አውሥአ — and she answered (ወ- + 3fs perfect, causative, w-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወአጣዕዎ: አጣዕዎ — and idolatry (?) (ወ- + noun, perhaps related to ጣዖት 'idol'; reading uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወአጽናዕክዋ: አጽነዐ — and I made her firm (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect, causative of ጸንዐ + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኢተሀጐልኩ: ሀጐለ — and I was not lost (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cs perfect, tä-stem passive of ሀጐለ)
glossary.ወኢተንተንኩ: ተንተነ — and I did not stagger (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 1cs perfect, quadriliteral)
glossary.ወኢትትዓመፁ: ተዓመፀ — and do not wrong one another (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 2mp jussive, reciprocal tä-stem of ዐመፀ)
glossary.ወኢወደቁ: ወደቀ — and they did not fall (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, w-d-q)
glossary.ወኢየኀድጋ: ኀደገ — and not he leaves her (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኢያንቀልቅል: አንቀልቀለ — and not he shakes (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, quadriliteral; meaning from context) (?)
glossary.ወኢይሜጽራ: ይሜጽራ — and not he … her (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect + -ሃ '3fs her'; root and meaning unknown) (?)
glossary.ወኢይሠረም: ሠረመ — and not he is torn (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወኢይረውያ: ረወየ — and not he drinks his fill of her (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect, G + -ሃ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወኢይሰጠም: ሰጠመ — and not he sinks (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, G, s-ṭ-m)
glossary.ወኢይተንትን: ተንተነ — and not he staggers (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, quadriliteral)
glossary.ወኢይተፍኣ: ተፍአ — and not he spits her out (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms imperfect + -ሃ '3fs her'; the ኣ is the suffix vowel after the root) (?)
glossary.ወኢይትቀላዕ: ቀለዐ — and not he is torn away (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, tä-stem passive) (?)
glossary.ወኢይትገደፍ: ተገድፈ — and it is not cast away (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, passive of ገደፈ)
glossary.ወኢይንሐድ: ነሐደ — and not he departs (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, G, n-ḥ-d) (?)
glossary.ወኢይንኀል: ነኀለ — and not he grows slack (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወኢይደቅ: ወደቀ — and not he falls (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, G, w-d-q)
glossary.ወኢይድኀፅ: ደኀፀ — and not he lags behind (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወኢይድክም: ደክመ — and not he grows weary (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive, G, d-k-m)
glossary.ወኢይጽነን: ጸነነ — and not he gives way (?) (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms jussive; stem uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወውሉዲ: ውሉድ — and his children (?) (ወ- 'and' + noun, plural + -ሁ '3ms his'; the printed ውሉዲ for ውሉዱ) (?)
glossary.ወዐረጉ: ዐርገ — and they ascended (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect, G, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ወዐቃብያኒሃ: ዐቃቢ — and her guardians (ወ- + noun, plural ዐቃብያን, stem ዐቃብያኒ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
glossary.ወያሀ: ያሀ — ? (?) (ወ- 'and' + a verb form; with the detached ፉ perhaps one word ያሀፉ; meaning unknown) (?)
glossary.ወያለጸልጽ: አለጸልጸ — and it makes falter, shake (?) (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, quadriliteral causative; meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወያልሕስ: ለሐሰ — and it weakens (?) (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect; stem and meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወያረዊ: አርወየ — and it quenches thirst (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, causative of ረወየ)
glossary.ወያስዖዝዝ: አስዖዘዘ — and it bewilders (?) (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, causative; meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ወያጐሥዕ: አጐሥዐ — and it fills (?) (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, causative-looking; the root ጐሥዐ is otherwise 'push, strike', so 'fills' is a guess from context) (?)
glossary.ወያጸግብ: አጸገበ — and it satisfies (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ጸገበ 'be sated')
glossary.ወይረውይዎ: ረወየ — and they drink their fill of it (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, r-w-y + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.ወይሰትይዎ: ሰትየ — and they drink it (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, s-t-y + -ዎ '3ms it')
glossary.ወይትኰነን: ኰነነ — and he is condemned (ወ- 'and' + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ኰነነ)
glossary.ወደቁ: ወደቀ — they fell (3mp perfect, G, w-d-q)
glossary.ወድኅንኩ: ድኅነ — and I was saved (ወ- 'and' + 1cs perfect, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ወጠይቅዋ: ጠየቀ — and examine it! (ወ- 'and' + 2mp imperative, G, ṭ-y-q + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ወጽልእዋ: ጸልአ — and hate it! (ወ- 'and' + 2mp imperative, G, ṣ-l-ʾ + -ዋ '3fs it')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ዐቀብ: ዐቀብ — steep slope, ascent (noun, in the genitive after ፍኖተ 'path of') (?)
glossary.ዐቃብያነ: ዐቃቢ — guardians of (noun, plural ዐቃብያን, construct)
glossary.ዐውዶ: ዐውድ — around (noun 'circuit' used as preposition; with the detached ሙ it reads ዐውዶሙ 'around them') (?)
glossary.ዘሠምረ: ሠምረ — which he was pleased with (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
glossary.ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
glossary.ዘሰክረ: ሰከረ — one who got drunk (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, s-k-r)
glossary.ዘበአማን: አማን — truly, in truth (ዘ- + በ- + noun; adverbial 'true, veritable')
glossary.ዘተረክበ: ተረክበ — who was found (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ረከበ)
glossary.ዘተነግረ: ነገረ — what was told (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ነገረ)
glossary.ዘትብሉ: ብህለ — what you say (ዘ- + 2mp imperfect, b-h-l)
glossary.ዘትካት: ትካት — of establishment, the established (?) (ዘ- + noun; cf. ተከለ 'plant, establish') (?) · ከመ ዘትካት 'as before, as formerly' (idiom, of the face and gaze) (?) · ዘትካት ልማድ 'the former (or established) custom' (ዘ- + noun qualifying ልማድ; ch. 89) (?)
glossary.ዘንትዐደው: ተዐደወ — that we transgress (ዘ- relative + tä-stem 1cp imperf., ʿ-d-w)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘከመዝ: ዘከመዝ — such, thus, in this way (ዘ- + ከመ + ዝ)
glossary.ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘጐየ: ጐየ — one who ran, fled (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, g-w-y)
glossary.ዘጾረ: ጾረ — one who bore, carried (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ṣ-w-r)
glossary.ዚአክሙ: ዚአ — your (possessive pronoun ዚአ + -ክሙ '2mp your'; 'in the command of yours')
glossary.የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ይበይታ: በየተ — he lodges (?) her, spends the night at her (?) (3ms imperfect, G, b-y-t + -ሃ '3fs her'; said of ships moored) (?)
glossary.ይትበርበር: በረበረ — he is plundered (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of በረበረ)
glossary.ይጥዕም: ጠዐመ — it is sweet, tastes (3ms imperfect, G, ṭ-ʿ-m)
